_comment: Offline demo transcript for the demo-signal (python -m market_ops.agent demo-signal). Cites only signal:<id>, so it validates regardless of how the corpus is chunked.

responses.text: Searching the runbooks for the 401 failure mode.

arguments.title: fetch_ohlcv rejected by Polygon with 401: check Connection polygon_default
arguments.summary: fetch_ohlcv failed on its first try with a 401 from Polygon. The DAG treats 401/403 as deterministic and does not retry, so the session's partition was not written.
arguments.probable_cause: The API key stored in Connection polygon_default was rejected by the vendor (invalid, expired, or revoked).

recommended_actions.step: Confirm which key is in use: airflow connections get polygon_default (the password prints masked).
Rotate the Polygon API key in Connection polygon_default.
Clear fetch_ohlcv for this run after the key is fixed.
